chunks: Tell them the parable of two men. We gave one two gardens of grapes surrounded by date-palm trees, with corn fields in between.
ai.seo_question: What is the parable of the two men in Surah Al-Kahf about?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse introduces the parable of the two men to contrast the arrogant landowner, who attributed his prosperity solely to his own effort, with the righteous believer who acknowledged divine grace. The lush description of the gardens—grapes, date palms, and crops—serves as a tangible metaphor for the transient nature of worldly wealth (dunya) compared to eternal spiritual rewards.
